issue: A broad attract-exit cooldown swallowed the next menu action.
fix: Consume the dismissal event itself; accept subsequent menu input.
evidence: Attract exit and credits navigation tests.

issue: The oxygen panel overlapped the objective.
fix: Place objectives below the full HUD, including its air meter.
evidence: River art review and phone/tablet layout checks.

issue: Canopy relics were poorly placed relative to the swing path.
fix: Place relics on the forward upswing.
evidence: Normal-rules full playthrough collects 10 of 12 total relics.

issue: Hiding the basket also hid the rescued friend.
fix: Show Pip outside the opened basket after rescue.
evidence: Final scene visibility assertion after the complete expedition.

issue: A lost graphics device could leave an invisible game.
fix: Preserve state and replace the renderer through the WebGL 2 fallback.
evidence: Graphics-device loss event, state retention, and recovered GPU pixel readback.

issue: Escape could hide the zero-health recovery menu while leaving play paused.
fix: Keep the recovery menu open until retry or return is chosen.
evidence: Zero-health, Escape, and checkpoint recovery test.

issue: A pending attract restart could later interrupt a real expedition.
fix: Reset the attract restart timer at the title and every run start.
evidence: New expedition remains playable beyond a simulated leftover restart deadline.

issue: Desktop camera look-ahead could put the explorer outside a portrait phone screen.
fix: Scale look-ahead and camera limits to the viewport, including checkpoint recovery.
evidence: Projected avatar visibility in portrait phone and tablet contexts.
